description: We are a team of young innovators driven by curiosity, creativity, and a passion for space exploration. Combining coding, research, and design, we transform ideas into immersive experiences. Through Horizon, our realistic space exploration game, we aim to inspire curiosity about the universe, make space exploration accessible, and encourage discovery beyond Earth. We believe imagination sparks innovation, and teamwork brings it to life.
summary:
Horizon is an immersive educational space exploration game that combines realistic space science, engineering, and interactive gameplay. Players can choose between Spacecraft Mission and Astronaut Mission, designing rockets, spacecraft, and planet-specific rovers using customisable components. In Spacecraft Mission, players build rockets, plan journeys, navigate space hazards, and explore celestial destinations. In Astronaut Mission, players launch from Earth, manually perform rocket separation, control crew capsules, dodge asteroids and comets, and land on planets or moons.

Players explore hyper-realistic celestial bodies featuring detailed terrain, craters, atmospheres, weather, and environmental conditions. They can drive rovers, sprint as astronauts, explore planetary surfaces, plant mission-specific flags, and conduct diverse scientific experiments.

The game includes quests, achievements, badges, experience points, levels, coin rewards, planetary unlocking, global rankings, and multiplayer missions. Dynamic solar system exploration, realistic physics, interactive landing simulations, and scientifically inspired challenges make every mission engaging.

The ultimate vision is to transform space exploration into an interactive learning adventure, inspiring players to understand the universe while experiencing the challenges of becoming real space explorers.
details:
Space Mission Design Game

Project Description

Space Mission Design Game is an interactive educational space exploration game that combines space science, engineering, and gaming. It allows players to experience the challenges of space exploration by designing spacecraft, planning missions, exploring celestial bodies, and conducting scientific experiments.

What Does the Project Do and How Does It Work?

The game offers two primary modes: Spacecraft Mission and Astronaut Mission. In Spacecraft Mission, players design rockets, customise spacecraft components, plan journeys, navigate obstacles, and explore planets and moons. In Astronaut Mission, players experience launching from Earth, manually separating rockets, navigating crew capsules, dodging space hazards, landing on celestial bodies, and exploring their surfaces.

Players can construct specialised rovers, conduct scientific experiments, plant mission-specific flags, complete quests, and unlock new destinations. AI-powered mission and landing assistants provide guidance throughout gameplay. Progression systems include achievements, badges, experience points, levels, and rewards.

What Are Its Benefits?

  • Makes complex space science accessible through interactive learning.
  • Encourages problem-solving, creativity, and engineering thinking.
  • Introduces planetary science, spacecraft design, and mission planning.
  • Demonstrates challenges associated with real space exploration.
  • Encourages curiosity about astronomy and scientific discovery.

Intended Impact

The project's primary impact is to inspire students and young learners to explore STEM subjects, understand space exploration, and develop an interest in science and engineering. It aims to transform passive learning into an engaging experience where players learn through experimentation, decisions, and exploration.

Tools, Technologies, and Software

The project is developed as a digital game using programming, interactive graphics, and 3D simulation technologies. Its development involves game logic, spacecraft and rover modelling, animation, physics, user-interface design, and AI-assisted guidance.

Note: Specific programming languages, frameworks, engines, and software should be listed according to the technologies actually used in development.

What Makes the Project Creative?

The game combines mission planning, spacecraft construction, astronaut gameplay, planetary exploration, scientific experiments, and AI assistance into one interactive experience. Its unique approach allows players to experience both the engineering and exploration aspects of space missions rather than simply learning about them through textbooks.

Hyper-realistic celestial environments, planet-specific rover engineering, interactive rocket separation, space navigation challenges, and progression-based exploration make the experience distinctive.

Factors Considered During Development

  • Scientific accuracy and educational value.
  • Realistic planetary environments and terrain.
  • Different gravitational and atmospheric conditions.
  • Appropriate spacecraft and rover capabilities.
  • Accessible and engaging gameplay.
  • Performance across different devices.
  • Fair challenges and meaningful progression.
  • User interface clarity and usability.
  • Integration of AI guidance and interactive learning.
  • Balancing realism with enjoyable gameplay.

The project ultimately aims to make space exploration more engaging, educational, and accessible while inspiring the next generation of scientists, engineers, and explorers.
